notes.title: Update #002 — Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h3]⚔️ Update #002 — Patch Notes[/h3]
A major update has arrived! Dive into a smoother, more strategic, and immersive gameplay experience.

[h2]🔧 Gameplay & Interface[/h2]
Complete visual overhaul of combat scenes for enhanced immersion

Invisible barriers added from levels 1 to 10 to streamline gameplay flow

New merchants appear every 2 floors

Save system revamped: progress is now saved at the start of each floor

Introduction of the new loot system

Map names and skull-based difficulty now displayed in the HUD

Difficulty balance adjusted according to the number of skulls

HUD and interface explanations updated in the official wiki

Wiki fully refreshed with the latest improvements

[h2]⚔️ Combat & Exploration[/h2]
More obstacles added to battle maps for deeper tactical options

Bonus loot now available during battles and explorations

Fixed bugs affecting specific chests

Mana potions added to chest rewards

Steel Guardian upgraded: increased defense and attack stats

[h2]✨ Spells & Enemy Units[/h2]
Healing and resurrection spells made more affordable

New spell “Fish Arrow” available from the beginning of the game

New enemy units introduced in challenge mode starting at floor 11

Fresh visuals added for enemy troops

[h2]🧠 Additional Improvements[/h2]
Loading screens now feature useful gameplay tips

Vendor markers added for easier identification

Translations added: now playable in German and Russian

notes.title: UPDATE #001 v041-3
notes.content:
[b]Early Access is now available[/b], and I'm really pleased with the initial feedback you've given it. It's very encouraging! As with any early access version, some bugs are to be expected, and I sincerely thank you for reporting them to me. In particular, a rather annoying bug that prevented me from facing the first boss—this problem has now been fixed.

For the occasion, a first patch note has been published with a list of fixes. A new feature has also been added regarding positioning, making the deployment phase more tactical and thoughtful.

A big thank you also to the YouTubers who made videos about the game! You can find all the links and information on our Discord server, and help us report any bugs you encounter to constantly improve the game.

Patch Note #001 v041-3
- Main menu popup disclaimer
- Esc and I key opens inventory menu
- Fixed bug with button in fire
- 5 fire mages at startup
- Added an explanation phrase for duplicating troops
- Added an explanation phrase for recruiting troops
- Turn numbers in combat
- Changed battle icon
- Added the options menu in battle
- New character images on the wiki
- Fixed a troop placement bug
